change: Only replace the recursive scored-move stable_sort with full stable insertion sort. Root sorts, scoring, tie order, search, HCE, rules, sampling and clock are unchanged. No NNUE or other experimental changes.

benchmark.sameTree: All completed layers, candidate order/scores and nodes must match. Node-capped path serial; parallel tested separately.

matches.stopRule: Finish all 12 regardless of scores; pause only for quota/access/execution blocker. No result-driven tuning, reruns, replacement or added games.
matches.rule: Third same public board/turn loses for mover; mate/stalemate priority;120 quiet plies draw;400 cap unresolved.

publication: Reviewed code and full evidence under existing user authorization; default unchanged absent reliable benefit.
